evidence_class: external captive feeding plus Japan telemetry and taxonomic activity summary
limitations: Feeding points encode qualitative captive feeding periods; telemetry is a Japanese activity proxy, not East Taiwan catch. Applies only to confirmed K. bigibbus, never generic white-hair aliases.

evidence_class: external captive feeding plus Japan activity studies and species summary
limitations: Studies report controlled feeding and seasonal diel differences outside East Taiwan; these points are a low-confidence time-of-day prior, not a bait response or bite rate.

evidence_class: diet background and western Taiwan fishery/larval context; no East Taiwan hourly activity response
limitations: Neutral time-of-day prior is used because available diet and regional studies do not establish hourly East Taiwan adult activity or feeding response; not evidence of constant activity.

evidence_class: Taiwan taxonomic activity summary plus historical northern Taiwan field study
limitations: Common-name black-hair records may refer to multiple species. Interpret only for an individually confirmed G. punctata; northern Taiwan historical and Japanese juvenile observations do not validate East Taiwan adult catch times.
